Edgar Rice Burroughs, Tarzan and the Jewels of Opar.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/edgar-rice-burroughs/tarzan-and-the-jewels-of-opar

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Edgar Rice Burroughs, the author, died 1950 (Wikidata Q148234, P570 = 1950-03-19).

First publication of the text used: 1916, in the United States; United States infobox, publisher A. C. McClurg, 1916. SE colophon: 'Tarzan and the Jewels of Opar was published in 1916 by Edgar Rice Burroughs.'

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1916, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 2011.
- Country of origin (United States): the country of first publication is the United States, so the rule above settles the country of origin too.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
